tasks.goal: Patrol the Charter Hall perimeter and verify charter display panels and the reserved-for-humans action list are readable on camera feed.
tasks.terrain: Polished exhibit hall floor with glass display cases, cable ramps along walls, and elevated charter plinths requiring low-body clearance.
success: Visit all 5 waypoint poses within 0.15 m tolerance
Panel OCR confidence >=0.85 on each charter display
Zero collisions logged in /collision_events
safety_stops: E-stop on human within 0.5 m
Stop if tilt exceeds 20 degrees
Return-to-dock below 20% battery
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward confirms the charter text captured by camera matches the canonical copy.

tasks.goal: Retrieve research summaries from a literature rack and deliver them to the evidence review desk in the Research Synthesis Lab.
tasks.terrain: Lab linoleum with rolling chairs, paper stacks, monitor arms, and narrow aisles between benches on the mesa-side lab wing.
success: Grasp success rate >=90% over 10 trials
Delivery pose within 0.10 m of desk marker
No dropped objects mid-transit
safety_stops: Release-and-halt if grip force anomaly detected
Pause on any human entering the workspace
Stop if arm joint torque exceeds 80% rated
tasks.human_in_loop: A researcher confirms the correct summary bundle was retrieved before it is filed.

tasks.goal: Carry the speaking token among seated participants during proposal debate and announce speaker order in the Proposal Forum.
tasks.terrain: Flat forum carpet with low podium steps, loose chair legs, and audience backpacks on the floor.
success: Token handed to correct next speaker in 95% of turns
Speech announcements match moderator queue
No falls or unplanned stops during 30-min session
safety_stops: Sit-down stop if IMU detects instability
Mute and halt if moderator raises stop gesture
Stop when battery below 15%
tasks.human_in_loop: The moderator approves the speaker queue; agents never decide debate outcomes.

tasks.goal: Walk the Operations Deck and inspect task-routing screens, cable trays, and thermal status of coordination workstations.
tasks.terrain: Raised floor tiles, under-desk cable bundles, stair edge between deck tiers, and door thresholds to the coastal-facing corridor.
success: Complete full deck circuit in under 12 min
Thermal anomaly localization within 0.3 m of ground truth
Stair tier traversal with zero foot slips reported
safety_stops: Auto-sit if slip detection triggers twice in 5 s
Halt at unlit or blocked doorways
E-stop pendant authority for any nearby operator
tasks.human_in_loop: An operator reviews flagged anomalies before any maintenance ticket is created.

tasks.goal: Fly a slow scan of the Progress Observatory metrics wall, imaging progress tiles against the charter's measurable outcomes.
tasks.terrain: Open mezzanine airspace 4 m high with suspended light fixtures, railing edges near the bluff-view glazing, and HVAC drafts from ocean-side vents.
success: Hover position hold within 0.10 m RMS during scans
All metrics tiles captured in focus at >=0.8 sharpness
No proximity warnings within 0.5 m of fixtures
safety_stops: Cut motors and controlled land on low-battery warning
Land immediately if optical flow fails
Geofence halt at railing plane
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward verifies captured metrics images before progress scores are published.

tasks.goal: Survey the outdoor logistics route between the Operations Deck loading area and the coastal bluff trailhead for the site supply run.
tasks.terrain: Mediterranean coastal scrub on sandstone bluff soil, gravel service road, coastal wind gusts, and erosion gullies above the Pacific.
success: Route of ~500 m completed with <=0.5 m lateral error
Hazard map flags all gullies wider than 0.3 m
Wheel slip ratio below 0.2 on gravel segments
safety_stops: Halt within 2 m of bluff edge line
Stop on GPS accuracy worse than 2 m HDOP
Return if wind gusts exceed 10 m/s
tasks.human_in_loop: A site supervisor approves the route plan and any supply-run schedule before dispatch.

tasks.goal: Load sequencing sample racks from the bench staging cart into the analyzer bay, mirroring Illumina lab workflows in digital twin form.
tasks.terrain: Fixed lab bench with rack slots, analyzer bay door recess, cable conduits, and a raised staging cart requiring 1.2 m reach.
success: 10/10 rack insertions with <=2 mm TCP placement error
Bay door interlock respected on every cycle
Contact force below 5 N during insertions
safety_stops: Joint-speed limit to 250 mm/s when any person in safety zone 2
Immediate stop on wrench threshold breach
Hold pose on loss of interlock signal
tasks.human_in_loop: A lab technician confirms each sample manifest before the analyzer run starts.

tasks.goal: Escort visitor groups between Charter Hall and the Proposal Forum while presenting the DAO's human-governance principle aloud.
tasks.terrain: Smooth concrete corridor with two 90-degree turns, entry threshold ramps, and occasional visitor strollers in the walkthrough path.
success: Walking speed sustained at 0.4 m/s with no falls over 20 escorts
2.0 m spacing maintained behind group lead
Speech narration completes each segment without truncation
safety_stops: Stop and brace if a visitor cuts within 1 m
Sit-to-safe-pose on footstep planner failure
Halt at any closed door awaiting human opening
tasks.human_in_loop: A docent sets group size and start times; visitors approve route via kiosk.
